meta.name: drive-motivation
meta.description: Design motivation systems using Autonomy, Mastery, and Purpose (AMP) for products and teams. Use when the user mentions "intrinsic motivation", "gamification isnt working", "rewards arent working", "autonomy", "mastery", "purpose-driven", "my team is disengaged", or "how do I motivate people". Also trigger when designing onboarding progression, fixing broken gamification, or building team structures that sustain high performance. Covers why carrot-and-stick fails and how to build progress systems. For habit-forming product loops, see hooked-ux. For retention behavior design, see improve-retention.

copy.tagline: 用自主、胜任、归属三要素设计激励系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队或产品需要提升内在动力而非依赖外部奖励。
copy.tagline_en: Design motivation systems using autonomy, mastery, and purpose.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to boost intrinsic motivation in teams or products.

howto.what: Claude 会基于自主性、掌控感和目标感（AMP）框架，帮你设计产品、团队或组织的内在动机系统。它会诊断现有激励方案，指出问题并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“内在动机”、“自主性”、“掌控感”、“目标驱动”、“团队缺乏动力”等关键词，或要求设计入职流程、修复失效的 gamification、构建高绩效团队结构时触发。

say.text: 我的团队缺乏动力，如何用 AMP 框架改进？
say.note: Claude 会诊断团队激励现状并给出具体建议。

say.text: 这个产品的 gamification 设计哪里出了问题？
say.note: Claude 会分析并指出外在奖励的缺陷。

say.text: 如何设计一个能激发内在动机的入职流程？
say.note: Claude 会提供自主性、掌控感和目标感的设计方案。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you design intrinsic motivation systems for products, teams, or organizations using the Autonomy, Mastery, and Purpose (AMP) framework. It diagnoses existing incentive schemes, identifies issues, and suggests improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "intrinsic motivation", "autonomy", "mastery", "purpose-driven", "team disengaged", or ask to design onboarding, fix broken gamification, or build high-performance team structures.

say_en.text: My team lacks motivation. How can I improve using the AMP framework?
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose the team's motivation and give specific advice.

say_en.text: What's wrong with this product's gamification design?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and point out flaws of extrinsic rewards.

say_en.text: How to design an onboarding that fosters intrinsic motivation?
say_en.note: Claude will provide design suggestions based on autonomy, mastery, and purpose.
